purpose: Original NativeZipper interpreter checks for actual mapped append, paid seal/rewind, and the complete blank-target mapped-copy caller. Enumerate every source word of lengths0..5 plus16 larger words at lengths8,16,32,64. Exercise all four Boolean maps and four arbitrary target prefixes for append. Check literal source/target tapes,markers,return labels and distinct absolute heads.1264 append+79 seal+316 full-copy cases,zero failures. Full copy includes target initialization,both linking jumps,STOP and rewind. This is a native setup primitive from an existing marked source,not a complete dimension/operand loader.
source:
import TransposeFollowup.NativeMappedCopy
open TransposeFollowup FixedTapeCompiler CopyMachine

def maps : List (Bool → Bool) := [id, Bool.not, fun _ => false, fun _ => true]
def bits (m n : Nat) : List Bool := (List.range m).map n.testBit

def words : List (List Bool) :=
  (List.range 6).flatMap (fun m => (List.range (2^m)).map (bits m)) ++
  [8,16,32,64].flatMap (fun m => [0,1,2^m-1,2^(m-1)+5].map (bits m))

def prefixes : List (List (Sym Bool)) :=
  [[], [.start], [.data false,.stop,.blank,.start], [.start,.data true]]

def positions (t : Fin 2) : Int := if t = 0 then -17 else 29

def appendCheck (f : Bool → Bool) (xs : List Bool) (pre : List (Sym Bool)) : Bool :=
  let c := NativeZipper.run (Microcode.MappedAppendFamily.program f) (4*xs.length+5)
    (NativeMappedAppend.cfg 0 (Counter.marked xs) ⟨pre,[]⟩ positions)
  decide (c.core.pc = 7) && decide (c.core.tapes 0 = Counter.marked xs) &&
    decide (c.core.tapes 1 = ⟨(symbols (xs.map f)).reverse ++ pre,[]⟩) &&
    decide (c.pos 0 = -17) && decide (c.pos 1 = 29+(xs.length:Int))

def sealCheck (xs : List Bool) : Bool :=
  let c := NativeZipper.run NativeSealBack.program (2*xs.length+5)
    (NativeSealBack.cfg .seal (NativeSealBack.openWord xs) (fun _ => -23))
  decide (c.core.pc = .done) && decide (c.core.tapes 0 = Counter.marked xs) &&
    decide (c.pos 0 = -23-(xs.length:Int))

def copyCheck (f : Bool → Bool) (xs : List Bool) : Bool :=
  let c := NativeZipper.run (NativeMappedCopy.program f) (6*xs.length+14)
    (NativeMappedCopy.zipperCfg (.init (.erase 0)) (Counter.marked xs) ⟨[],[]⟩ positions)
  decide (c.core.pc = .seal .done) && decide (c.core.tapes 0 = Counter.marked xs) &&
    decide (c.core.tapes 1 = Counter.marked (xs.map f)) &&
    decide (c.pos 0 = -17) && decide (c.pos 1 = 29)

def allChecks : Nat × Nat × Nat × Nat := Id.run do
  let mut app := 0
  let mut sealed := 0
  let mut copied := 0
  let mut failures := 0
  for xs in words do
    sealed := sealed+1
    if !sealCheck xs then failures := failures+1
    for f in maps do
      copied := copied+1
      if !copyCheck f xs then failures := failures+1
      for pre in prefixes do
        app := app+1
        if !appendCheck f xs pre then failures := failures+1
  return (app,sealed,copied,failures)
#eval allChecks
